construction.implementation_origin: Original implementation created for this isolated build.

shared_schema.input: Strict government-form JSON: schema_version, synthetic, citizen, privacy, service_request, benefits_application, policy_documents.
shared_schema.output: One envelope with schema_version, synthetic, status, stage, PII-minimized context, accumulated results, audit, safeguards.
shared_schema.validation: validate() checks input and each stage boundary. Shared context, policy and evidence validators enforce shapes, limits, synthetic identifiers, exact source citations, stage order, handoff integrity and safeguards.
shared_schema.errors: One stdout JSON object with status error and exit 2; success status ok and exit 0. Error messages do not echo input PII or file paths.

cross_stage_handoffs.data: Validated minimized context and personalized next step based on benefits-application status.
Exact source quotations, policy IDs, unresolved question and onboarding next step.
Validated evidence set and next step. Only programs attached to cited policies can be suggested.

behavior.onboarding: Status-specific actionable instruction for draft, submitted or needs-information applications.
behavior.support: Offline deterministic keyword matching against supplied policy sentences, scoped to the requested service; up to three short exact quotations, otherwise explicit abstention.
behavior.research: Decision-review evidence with provenance and explicit uncertainty about completeness, freshness, conflicts and eligibility.
behavior.discovery: Stable policy-ID order of evidence-backed services, with reasons, source IDs, next steps and required human review.
behavior.privacy: Demonstration consent gate; drops citizen identity fields before first handoff; rejects direct contact and identity-number patterns in public text and repetitions of provided private values. No persistence or external transmission.
behavior.explainability: Deterministic rule IDs, policy IDs and verbatim source quotations support review without retaining direct citizen identity fields.
behavior.accessibility: Plain text instructions and short excerpts, explicit English-only validation, retained screen-reader/plain-text preferences, no image/color dependency.
behavior.fixtures: Clearly synthetic personas, invented identifiers, reserved .invalid email and a non-traceable invented address.

included: One integrated pipeline and shared validation layer
Deterministic local execution with no model provider
PII minimization, source provenance and human-review safeguards
excluded: Real citizen data or real government policy
Legal, Privacy Act, GDPR or Section 508 compliance certification
Semantic entailment, complete PII detection, contradiction resolution or policy freshness verification
Multilingual support, identity verification or authentication
Databases, production case management and live service integrations
LLM calls or optional provider integrations
